findings.title: Replay ignores solver execution receipts
findings.why_it_matters: A retained evidence directory can receive a numerical PASS even if no Gmsh, ElmerGrid, or ElmerSolver command receipt exists. Replay checks regenerated geometry and semantic plausibility of editable solver output, but never binds that output to a successful recorded solver execution; its self-reported artifact hashes only detect changes relative to the equally editable assessment. Because the harness turns a successful replay into `THERMAL.POWER_ENTRY.BRIDGE_NECK_NUMERICAL` PASS, a partial or fabricated run can be accepted as numerical evidence. Require completed, typed per-tool receipts and validate their exact command, exit status, timeout, and output hashes during replay.
findings.suggested_fix: Have run_process write a completed receipt after each successful command with exit status and hashes of stdout, stderr, and declared outputs; in read_cases/replay require and validate Gmsh, ElmerGrid, and ElmerSolver receipts for every case against the expected executable role, arguments, working directory, timeout, and result hashes before parsing solver results.
evidence: zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/neck_run.rs:247-255 -- replay validates the assessment schema, board/model, inventory, and cases, but invokes no command-receipt or backend-hash validation.

zapote/packages/zapote-thermal/src/lib.rs:254-260 -- run_process writes command.json before launching and records program, arguments, cwd, environment, and timeout, but no completion status or output binding.
zapote/packages/zapote-harness/src/bridge_thermal.rs:54-62 -- a successful replay with matching currents emits Finding::pass for THERMAL.POWER_ENTRY.BRIDGE_NECK_NUMERICAL.

testing_gaps: No replay/harness test removes or rewrites a per-case solver.command.json (and reconciles assessment.artifacts) to prove that execution receipts, not just plausible raw outputs, are required for the numerical rule to pass.
